name: Happy Set: Altaria & Latios & Infernape & Maushold

releases.name: Happy Set: Altaria & Latios & Infernape & Maushold

description.text:
The Happy Set Altaria & Latios & Infernape & Maushold (宝可梦卡牌 嗨皮组合 七夕青鸟&拉帝欧斯&烈焰猴&一家鼠) came out on 12 September 2025 with Dark Crystal Blaze, the third Happy Set. Like the others, it is a box for two to four friends to play together. It held four ready-to-play 60-card decks, built around Altaria ex, Latios, Infernape and Maushold ex, each with a card explaining how it plays, plus a beginner's guide, two battle guides, damage counters and two coins. With the decks came rules for two to four players, a 10-card modification pack for changing a deck after a lost game, a one-card reward pack for the winner and seven Collect 151 event packs to share out. With luck one of the four decks was a holo deck, the same cards in holo, which turned up 1.6% of the time. A Happy Deck (嗨皮卡组) box holding one of the four decks at random came out the same day.

From 12 September to 19 October 2025 shops held four-player Happy Together 2 (一起来嗨皮2) events with its decks, where the winner took the reward pack. Each card carries a small silhouette of its deck's Pokémon. Its cards are numbered out of 64; four basic Energy, Fire, Water, Psychic and Metal, print their type code instead of a number.
